text: Hello, boys and girls.Nice to see you again.Welcome back to my class.Today, we will go on learning unit four, reading, different people and different jobs.Please get your student's book and your worksheet ready.In today's class, you will read another text about different people and their jobs.This time, they are the people we usually see on our way to school.First, let me tell you the people I usually see and what they are doing on my way to school.Every morning, I see parents taking their children to school.I also see people doing morning exercises in the park.Then, who do you see on your way to school?What are they doing?You can use the sentence pattern, see somebody doing, to share your idea.Henry, please.I see some traffic police directing the traffic.I also see some delivery men delivering parcels and food.Good.Vivi, please.I see people going to snack bars to have breakfast.I also see people buying food from the market.Quite good.Thank you.Then, who or what does Tom see on his way to school?Before reading the text, I will show you some pictures.Look at this picture.Who does Tom see?He sees some street cleaners cleaning the streets.The second picture, who else does Tom see?He sees a newspaper seller selling newspapers.What about the third picture?Maybe Tom sees a bakery on his way to school.The last picture, he also sees a flower shop on his way to school.I think we can predict what the text is about with the help of the pictures.我们可以通过读图来预测课文内容。Now, it's time to read the text.Please turn to page 32.How many paragraphs are there in the text?Five paragraphs.Please read the text quickly and circle the jobs or the names of the people Tom sees on his way to school.Boys and girls, how many jobs or people did you find?Four, right?Cindy, would you like to tell us what or who they are?Where do you find them?In paragraph 2, Tom sees the street cleaners.In paragraph 3, he sees Mr.In paragraph 4, he sees Mrs.Liang.You're right, thank you.From paragraph 2 to paragraph 5, we can read about the people doing four different jobs.Each paragraph describes a job.第二段至第五段,每段描述了一种职业。Then, what does paragraph 1 tell us?Let's read together.Every morning, Tom sees a lot of people on his way to school.Does it tell us the important details, the personal feeling, or the main idea?Think about it.The first paragraph is the topic sentence of the text.It tells us the main idea.第一段是课文的主题句,介绍了本文的主旨大意。Here are some mind maps which can show the structure of the text.Please think about it.Can you choose the proper one?Right, we choose B.It shows how the passage is organized properly.The topic sentence shows the main idea of the text.The following paragraphs mention the people doing four different jobs.Now, let's read paragraph 2 and answer two questions.What does Tom see?What do the street cleaners do?Do you find the answers?Vivi, what does Tom see?He sees the street cleaners cleaning the streets.Devi, what do the street cleaners usually do?They sweep the streets and collect rubbish.They also empty the rubbish bins.Right.Now, let's write down the keywords in the map according to the questions.You should write the keywords about the street cleaners in the first box.I will give you 20 seconds.You can find the map in Task 1 on your worksheet.Time is up.This is Harry's mind map.Please read it carefully.What do you think of it?Quite clear, right?He just wrote down the keywords instead of the whole sentences.It is a good way.So remember to write down the keywords of the text.Now it's your turn to read paragraphs 3, 4, and 5.Then complete the mind map.While reading, think about the questions.What do they do?Remember, just write down the keywords.You have two minutes.And tell what you think of it.Information in the mind map, for example, what does Tom see and what do they do, but I don't think she needs to write down the complete sentence.For example, she can just write baked bread and cakes instead of he bakes bread and cakes.Sell newspapers instead of she sells newspapers.Thank you, David.I agree with you.Boys and girls, while reading the text, do you notice the sentences?In paragraph 2, they start work early.In paragraph 3, he opens his shop early.In paragraph 4, she starts work early too.In paragraph 5, she goes to the flower market early every morning to buy flowers for her shop.What do these sentences tell us?These people all start work early every morning, right?So what do you think of their jobs?Xinyi, what's your idea?I think it's not easy to start work early every morning.The street cleaners, Mr.Ma, Mrs.Liang and Mr.Hu all work very hard.Thanks to their hard work, we can walk on clean streets, we can eat bread and cakes, and we can enjoy beautiful flowers.And I also think we need to respect them all.Do you agree?Now it's time to retell the text according to the mind map.You will have two minutes to prepare.Vivi, would you like to have a try?They sweep the streets, collect rubbish, and empty the rubbish bins.They start work early.Tom sees people going to Mr.Ma's bakery to buy bread and cakes.Ma bakes bread and cakes and opens his shop early.Tom sees people buying newspapers from Mrs.She sells newspapers.She starts work early, too.Tom also sees Mrs.Hu selling flowers.She goes to the flower market early every morning to buy flowers for her shop.Thank you, Vivi.You did a good job.Next, you will watch a video and write about the people Harry sees on his way to school.Please watch the video carefully and find out who Harry sees and what they do.Try to write down some keywords in the mind map first.It is in Task 2 on your worksheet.The structure we've talked about may help you.Are you ready?Let's go.Have you written down the keywords?I will play it one more time.Now you have one minute to prepare.Have you finished?This is Ricky's mind map.Please read it.Did Ricky write down all the key information?Yes, he did.But I think you can add more details because proper details can make your passage better.For example, the fruit seller goes to the fruit market early every morning to buy fruits for his shop.Next, it's your turn to write a passage about the people Harry sees on his way to school.Attention, please.You need to introduce the main idea at the beginning and talk about the people in the video clip.And you also need to use the sentence pattern, see somebody doing.And you also need to use the content, add the content.每天早上,Henry看到很多人在他的家裡。他會想,我可以去找他嗎?我會去找他。Henry看到很多人在他的家裡。他把車輛移到鄰居。Henry看到他們移動人們的物品到他們的新房子。Henry看到水果店在賣水果給人們。他每天早上去水果市場去買水果給他的店鋪。車輛警察很忙碌。他指導車輛警察,並且負責車輛車禍。有時,Henry看到有些孩子在路上幫助他。Henry也看到送貨員騎摩托車。他把貨物和食物送給人們。你覺得Sindy寫的什麼?我們來看看檢查單位。是否有正確和正確的開始?她在影片中寫了關於所有人的文字?她用了文字模式看見人們在做什麼,對嗎?她還加了一些詳細的資訊來描述人們的工作。做得好,Sindy!今天,我們讀了文章,並且學會了用文章模式來幫助我們讀和寫。另外,我們發現了我們通常在學校的路上看到的那些人幫助我們改善我們的生活。今天這麼多!這是你們的家務!
